title: lonicera chrysantha subsp. koehneana
intro: Lonicera chrysantha subsp. koehneana, commonly known as the Golden Honeysuckle, is a type of flowering plant in the honeysuckle family. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera chrysantha subsp. koehneana include anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve congestion and soothe the respiratory system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
